description: Client-side script for 'Delivery Trip' form in ERPNext, managing form setup, refresh actions, route calculations, customer notifications, and related 'Delivery Stop' interactions.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initial setup for the Delivery Trip form, setting indicator format and query filters for driver, address, and contact fields.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Defines actions on form refresh, including adding custom buttons for expense claim, customer notification, and fetching customers from delivery note.

methods.name: calculate_arrival_time
methods.description: Calculates arrival times based on route, requires driver address.

methods.name: driver
methods.description: Fetches and sets the email of the selected driver.

methods.name: optimize_route
methods.description: Optimizes the delivery route, requires driver address.

methods.name: notify_customers
methods.description: Sends email notifications to customers, checks for delivery notes, and uses email templates.
